messages.subject: Trial vs io configuration
parts:
Hi,
I've been trying to fit a point idependence model to some mrds data. I'm having a hard time getting a detection function to fit. The dsmodel fits well but the mrmodel doesn't.
I supect that there may have been some sort of failure of the independence protocol leading to something like behavioual response in the mr data.
This may well be why a trail configuration is more robust than a full independence configuration.
My question is this: is trial less powerful than full independence configuration?
It seems we'd lose some mr data but perhaps the dsmodel would make up for that?
Thank you.

messages.author: 3bd8c63129564378
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Trial vs io configuration
parts:
Hello,
To answer my own question: On our data, the trial configuration was a better fit (the mrmodel component of GOF chisq was p>0.05 at least) but the SE of p-hat was slightly larger. Perhaps this is a compromise we must make.
Lyndon.
